case_title: MONETARY MANAGEMENT CORPORATION VS. R.A.T. OIL INC.

docket_entries.description: SERVICE OF COMPLAINT BY CERTIFIED MAIL FILED BY PLAINTIFF MONETARY MANAGEMENT CORPORATION AS TO DEFENDANT R.A.T. OIL INC.

PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF (CERTIFIED MAIL GREEN CARD RECEIVED ON APRIL 22, 2015 FROM THE POST OFFICE. THE FRONT OF THE CARD HAS A POSTAL STICKER THAT SAYS UNABLE TO FORWARD/FOR REVIEW) SERVED APR-22-2015, COURT CERTIFIED MAIL RETURNED SERVED AS TO DEFENDANT R.A.T. OIL INC.
DECLARATION OF APPEARANCE ON BEHALF OF CORPORATION PURSUANT TO CCP 116.540 (B)-(H) FILED BY DEFENDANT R.A.T. OIL INC.

THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITH PREJUDICE BY PLAINTFF. CASE SETTLED BETWEEN PARTIES PRIOR TO THE HEARING. PLAINTIFF WAS PRESENT. DEFENDANT WAS PRESENT. DEFENDANT WAS REPRESENTED BY KARANDEEP S. SANDHU--MANAGER. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: DONALD S. MITCHELL. CLERK: P. NATT. NOT REPORTED. (506)
MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $820.87 FILED BY MONETARY MANAGEMENT CORPORATION AS TO DEFENDANT R.A.T. OIL INC. ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR MAY-27-2015 AT 03:30 PM IN DEPT 506
